title: Hike Koko Head's 1,048 Steps with Ms. Hawaii for Summit Views
blurb:
Aloha Adventurers! Hike with Ms. Hawai'i 2025 on this steep but rewarding trail. Please note: while this hike isn’t long, it is steep and challenging — best for those with hiking or intense cardio experience.

Join us for the Koko Crater Railway Trail Challenge to climb 1,048 historic steps to the summit for breathtaking panoramic views of Oahu’s coastline. It will be an unforgettable guided VIP experience.

✨ Why Choose This Tour?
✔️ Local Insights & Motivation — Guided support, history, and hiking tips.
✔️ Scenic Beauty — Choose stunning sunset views or daytime sweeping island scenic views.
✔️ Mindful & Fun — Go at your pace, and/or challenge yourself.
✔️ Photos & Memories — We’ll capture epic photos of you conquering the climb!
✔️ VIP Ride — Pick-up/drop-off in the stylish Alfa Romeo.

You will be picked up in Waikiki & will ride in comfort to & from the hike. Follow on IG @MsHawaii2025 or @sixdegreesoulhawaii for tour highlights. Mahalo for booking with 6 Degree Soul!
